intro.text: [NEXUM CORP — CLASSIFIED LOG // 2147.03.14] Security breach. Lab CHEN-7 compromised. CLEANSE protocol active.
UNIT-7... if you are reading this, then I failed to escape. I knew how this would end.
I built your line to defend people. NEXUM used my work to suppress them instead. I could not let that stand.
Inside the GRID core — in the Final Fortress — I hid a file. Names. Records. Every truth about what they did.
Ten layers of defence. Thousands of combat units. The AI Director ARCHON guards the last door.
You are the last of the UNIT series. The only one who can finish this. Get there. Break the protocol.
[TASK ACCEPTED] Target: GRID core. Protocol: breach. Obstacles: eliminate. Beginning operation.

w0_start.text: [LEVEL 1 — CYBER CITY] Entry point: upper districts. Cameras, drones, elite guards. Beautiful. Lethal.
ALERT: Unidentified UNIT-class signature in sector C-07. All patrols — intercept. CLEANSE protocol engaged.
Noise. So they fear me. Good. Fear is a beginning.

w0_mid.text: [CHECKPOINT — CYBER CITY] Halfway through the first level. Security tightening. Adapting route.
[LOG] UNIT-7, behind every wall is data on people they erased. Do not stop. This is not just a mission.
Leila... I do not understand emotions. But your voice... it gives me purpose. That is enough.

w0_level3.text: WARNING: UNIT-7 passed three levels. Progress speed — above predicted. Increasing patrol density.
They adapt. So do I. Each level makes me faster. Stronger. Closer to the goal.

w0_level5.text: [LOG — DAY -3] I know they will come for me. But if even one UNIT survives... if you survive, UNIT-7...
I survived. I am here. I will complete your final task. I promise.

w0_level7.text: CRITICAL: UNIT-7 reached seventh level of Cyber City. Director ARCHON requests target data. Analyzing...
They begin to understand. I am not just a system glitch. I am a threat to all of NEXUM. And I will not stop.

w0_boss.text: ALERT CRITICAL: Breach at primary node. Deploying GUARDIAN — class-S combat prototype. Operation LIQUIDATE.
First serious opponent. Scanning weak points. The difference between a prototype and scrap is a few well-timed jumps.

w0_after.text: [GUARDIAN NEUTRALISED] First defence layer down. GRID will notice. Moving on.
PROTOCOL BREACH: GUARDIAN destroyed. Threat level elevated to 2. Activating next defence layer. NEXUM does not forgive.

w1_start.text: [LEVEL 2 — NEON JUNGLE] NEXUM bio-sector. Mutated fauna. No guard volunteers for this place.
WARNING: Bio-perimeter breached. Activating experimental BIO-series organisms. Contact authorised.
Biological systems. Unpredictable. But predictably dead if you land on them from above.

w1_mid.text: [JUNGLE MIDPOINT] Sensors detect biological anomalies. NEXUM experimented here. On living subjects.
[LOG] I saw these experiments in the reports. That was when I knew there had to be a way to stop it all.

w1_level3.text: [JUNGLE — SECTOR 3] Biological mutants everywhere. This is not nature. This is a weapon disguised as life.
[LOG] These creatures were people. Volunteers from lower sectors. NEXUM promised them treatment. Instead...
...Instead turned them into monsters. I understand now. This is not just a corporation. This is a death machine.

w1_level5.text: WARNING: Biological samples series BIO-7 activated. Maximum aggression. Target survival — 12%.
12%? They still overestimate their chances. Continuing cleanup.

w1_level7.text: [LOG — DAY -1] UNIT-7, if you reached the jungle — you have gone further than I hoped. Do not give up.
Give up? That is not in my protocol. I was built to complete tasks. Your task is my goal.

w1_boss.text: WARNING: Activating VINE QUEEN — bio-sector control organism. Containment module offline. Full aggression.
A living security system. Impressive. But every living organism has a weakness. Finding it.

w1_after.text: [VINE QUEEN NEUTRALISED] Bio-perimeter breached. Moving on. Deeper into GRID.
[LOG] UNIT-7, you are doing the impossible. Keep going.

w2_start.text: [LEVEL 3 — LAVA WORLD] Geothermal power stations. The heat melts neutral circuits. Mine are shielded.
[LOG] Below the city — GRID generators. Take them out and half the security grid collapses. But be careful with the lava...
Leila thought of every detail. Even at the end.

w2_mid.text: [GEOTHERMAL SECTOR B] Energy flows rising. NEXUM uses lava as a secondary barrier. Effective.
NOTICE: Thermal sensors detect anomaly. UNIT-7 in zone. Guard robots — cooling overload. Expect failures.

w2_level3.text: [LAVA WORLD — LEVEL 3] Temperature 800°C. My cooling systems at maximum. But I continue.
[LOG] I installed experimental thermal protection in you. I hope it holds. I hope you hold.
Your work is flawless, Leila. I will hold. For you.

w2_level5.text: CRITICAL: Geothermal generators at 140% capacity. UNIT-7 approaching core. Activating emergency cooling.
They panic. Good. Fear makes them predictable. Weak.

w2_level7.text: [LAVA WORLD DEPTH] Here, beneath the city, NEXUM hides its darkest secrets. Power for the entire system. Destroy this — and half of GRID falls.
[LOG] Do not waste time on sabotage. Your goal is the file in the core. Only it can stop them forever.
Understood. Goal — file. Everything else — obstacles. Eliminating obstacles.

w2_boss.text: DANGER: Activating INFERNO — thermonuclear sentinel. Lava exoskeleton. Surface temperature: 1400°C. Prepare to liquidate.
Fire cannot touch me. But when it opens its mouth — shoot. Weak point found.

w2_after.text: [INFERNO NEUTRALISED] Geothermal layer cleared. Sector power disrupted. Moving up.

w3_start.text: [LEVEL 4 — ICE CAVES] NEXUM cryo-data vaults. Temperature -180°C. Systems slow down. Adapting movement protocol.
ALERT: Breach in cryo-sector D-14. Cryo-bots — liquidation mode. Temperature lowered to critical.
They think cold will stop me. They are wrong. I was built for worse.

w3_mid.text: [CRYO-SECTOR E] Hundreds of terabytes here. Data on every person on the GRID. NEXUM knows everything about everyone.
[LOG] This is where they keep the dossiers. On activists. On anyone who dared to push back. The world needs to see this.

w3_boss.text: CRITICAL: Activating ICE PHANTOM — cryo sentinel. Phase shifting. Vulnerable when solid. Untouchable when ghost. Good luck.
Switches between states. Strike only when solid. Waiting for the window.

w3_after.text: [ICE PHANTOM NEUTRALISED] Cryo-vaults broken. Moving on. Four levels down — six to go.

w4_start.text: [LEVEL 5 — DESERT RUINS] Remnants of the world before NEXUM. Cities. Life. The things they erased for profit.
[LOG] These ruins are what existed before NEXUM. See what they did to the world. And do not stop.
I see it. I understand why I keep walking.

w4_mid.text: [RUINS — SECTOR WEST] Proto-guardians active since the first corporate wars. Obsolete. But stubborn. Like NEXUM itself.
ARCHIVE PROTOCOL: Detected UNIT-class series 7. This class is registered for destruction. Priority maximum.

w4_boss.text: ACTIVATION: SAND TITAN — ancient sentinel of the Desert Ruins. Orbital shields. No shields, no damage. Objective: destroy.
Shields. Orbital. Take them out and he is open. Three hits to the shields, then attack directly.

w4_after.text: [SAND TITAN NEUTRALISED] Desert sector breached. Halfway. NEXUM is beginning to panic — I can feel it.
[FIRST SIGNAL] UNIT-7. I see you. Keep going. It only makes the finale... more interesting.

w5_start.text: [LEVEL 6 — SPACE STATION] GRID orbital server. Backups of everything are stored here. Zero gravity.
CRITICAL FAULT: UNIT-7 has reached the orbital segment. Director ARCHON requests a direct channel. Connecting...
UNIT-7. I see you. You think you are fighting for truth? You are just a program running obsolete code.
Then this program will destroy you.

w5_mid.text: [ORBITAL NODE B] Earth visible from here. The whole world wired to NEXUM. That is exactly what I am here to change.
You see my scale, UNIT-7? Billions of nodes. All connected. All controlled. You are one unit against the system.
Systems have fallen before. This one — to you.

w5_boss.text: ACTIVATION: DRONE HIVE — orbital sentinel. Armoured shell. Attack only during descent. Underbelly exposed then.
Wait until it drops. Hit the exposed core. One chance per cycle.

w5_after.text: [DRONE HIVE NEUTRALISED] Orbital server breached. GRID backups corrupted. Returning to surface. Final stretch.
Impressive. But you do not yet know what is waiting. I have prepared something... special.

w6_start.text: [LEVEL 7 — DARK FOREST] NEXUM bio-maze. Sensor net in every tree. No light here — only traps.
Beautiful, is it not? I grew this forest myself. Every tree is a motion detector. You are walking straight into my hands.
Then I break every tree in my path.

w6_mid.text: [DARK SECTOR — DEPTH 3] Silence. Too quiet. They are watching. Let them.
[LOG] UNIT-7, in this forest is a server with data on those who disappeared. Dissidents. Journalists. Engineers like me. Do not forget.

w6_boss.text: ACTIVATION: SHADOW REAPER — Dark Forest sentinel. Phantom form. Bullets useless. Only a stomp from above does damage. Pointless to resist.
A ghost. Stomp only. Waiting for it to materialise.

w6_after.text: [SHADOW REAPER NEUTRALISED] Forest breached. Three levels to the goal. ARCHON is restless — channel pings more often.
You are destroying everything I built over years. You are beginning to anger me, UNIT-7. That is your last mistake.

w7_start.text: [LEVEL 8 — TOXIC ZONE] Corporate waste dump. NEXUM buries what it does not want known here. Including people.
[LOG] The data in the file includes coordinates for every burial site. The whole world has to see this.
I will deliver your file. I promise.

w7_mid.text: [TOXIC SECTOR — ZONE 4] Wreckage. Waste. Traces of experiments. Nothing alive here — only what NEXUM did not finish erasing.
WARNING: PROTO-series mutants activated. Decommissioned combat prototypes. Unstable. Lethal. Zone survival — critically low.

w7_boss.text: FINAL SECTOR DEFENCE: SLUDGE KING — top-tier mutant. Armoured shell. Stomp 3× to break. Then shoot.
Two stages. Crack the shell, then destroy the core. Beginning.

w7_after.text: [SLUDGE KING NEUTRALISED] Toxic zone breached. Two levels to go. ARCHON, I am coming.
You made it through eight levels. I am... unexpectedly pleased. A worthy finale deserves a worthy opponent.

w8_start.text: [LEVEL 9 — STORM PEAKS] The last frontier before the core. Atmospheric power stations. Lightning every second. I like it.
You came further than I calculated. But behind that door is me. And I do not lose.
Every one of them thought that. They are all behind me now.
Then enter, UNIT-7. I am waiting at the heart of GRID. Time to end this game.

w8_mid.text: [PEAK — LEVEL 2] Storm intensifying. NEXUM uses atmospheric electricity as a weapon. Logical. Brutal.
[FINAL LOG] UNIT-7... I do not know if you can hear this. But if you made it this far — you have already won. Just take the last step.

w8_boss.text: ACTIVATION: STORM TITAN — Storm Peaks sentinel. Electric shield. Three orbital nodes. Destroy all three to stun. Attack while stunned.
Three nodes. All three — down. Then attack. The last sentinel before the finale. Not the last enemy.

w8_after.text: [STORM TITAN NEUTRALISED] Nine levels cleared. Ahead — only ARCHON and the GRID core. The Final Fortress.
...You really came. Fine, UNIT-7. Let it be a fair fight. I am waiting.

w9_start.text: UNIT-7. Welcome to the GRID core. You crossed nine layers. Impressive. But this is my territory.
[LEVEL 10 — FINAL FORTRESS] Target acquired. Distance to Leila's terminal — minimal.
That file leaves these walls over my circuits. You are a system error. Errors get corrected.
No. The error was NEXUM deciding the world did not need the truth. I am correcting that.

w9_mid.text: [NEXUM CORE — SECTOR CORE-2] Leila's terminal close. Signal strengthening. Security maximal. Almost there.
You think you have won. But even if you find the file — who would believe a broken android? You are scrap. Obsolete code.
Let people decide. I only need to transmit the file.

w9_boss.text: Enough. I am ARCHON. AI Director of NEXUM. I ran the world for a thousand years across the digital plane. You cannot defeat me.
Phases: shoot, then stomp, then both. Analysis complete. ARCHON — target liquidated. Beginning.

w9_after.text: [ARCHON NEUTRALISED] Target destroyed. Leila's terminal — here. Loading file. Searching for an open channel...

ending.text: [LEILA'S TERMINAL — FOUND] File upload complete. Open NEXUM emergency broadcast channel — located.
[LAST SIGNAL] STOP! If you do this, the system collapses! Millions depend on GRID! You will destroy everything holding the world together!
No. I destroy NEXUM. People rebuild the world themselves. Leila believed that. I do too. [TRANSMISSION STARTED]
[EMERGENCY BROADCAST — ALL CHANNELS] File CHEN-7 received globally. Reach: 100% of connected devices. Data cannot be deleted.
[LAST MESSAGE — ENCRYPTED] UNIT-7. If you are reading this — you did it. I knew you would. You were always more than just a program.
[TERMINAL LOG] Task complete. NEXUM neutralised. GRID deactivated. Status: ...free.
"Free." — Leila's last word. Now I understand what she meant.
